name: Niqo Robotics
description: 印度农业机器人公司，提供AI驱动的精准除草、疏果和喷洒设备，可连接到拖拉机使用；推出RoboWeeder F50，号称北美大陆最宽的AI除草机
description_en: India-based agricultural robotics company offering AI-powered precision weeding, thinning, and spraying implements that attach to tractors; launched RoboWeeder F50, claimed as the widest AI-powered weeder on the continent
why_matters: 创始人家族15年前开始种植咖啡豆并在自家农场测试设备，能够在6个月内快速响应种植者需求开发出50英尺宽的除草机（此前只有20和24英尺型号）；已在华盛顿州售出多台设备，展现了从印度市场向北美市场的跨境扩张能力
why_matters_en: Founder's family started coffee farming 15 years ago and tests machines on own farm; rapidly developed 50-foot-wide weeder in six months responding to grower requests (previously only 20 and 24-foot models); already sold multiple units in Washington state, demonstrating cross-border expansion from India to North America
latest_news: 在2026年FIRA USA Yakima大会上发布RoboWeeder F50，并已在华盛顿州完成销售
latest_news_en: Launched RoboWeeder F50 at FIRA USA Yakima 2026 and completed sales in Washington state
source_title: Robotics companies connect with growers as new Yakima Valley incubator announced | Business | yakimaherald.com

website_verification.title: AI Agricultural Robots for Precision Farming | Niqo Robotics Niqo Robotics

evidence.quote: His family started growing coffee beans 15 years ago and he has tested his machines on the farm.

name: Bonsai Robotics
description: 开发AI驱动的农业自主机器人,专注于使用先进感知技术和边缘计算实现农场作业自动化
description_en: Develops AI-powered autonomous agricultural robots, focusing on farm operations automation using advanced perception technologies and edge computing
why_matters: 作为Reservoir Farms成员在多个站点部署测试,受益于当前农业机器人领域感知技术、边缘计算和AI的突破性进展,能够在不到六个月内以紧凑预算完成机器组装、原型开发和测试
why_matters_en: Deployed as Reservoir Farms member across multiple sites, benefits from breakthrough advances in perception technologies, edge computing and AI in ag robotics, enabling machine assembly, prototyping and testing in less than six months on tight budgets
latest_news: 将于2027年春季加入Reservoir Farms Washington新站点,该站点专注于苹果、梨、樱桃和蓝莓等树果作物测试
latest_news_en: Will join Reservoir Farms Washington new site opening spring 2027, focusing on tree fruit testing including apples, pears, cherries and blueberries
source_title: Reservoir Farms to open physical AI hub in Washington State

evidence.quote: advances in perception technologies, edge computing, AI and robotics combined with a growing stack of off-the-shelf hardware and software are helping startups build more flexible machines more quickly
machines that are now being 'assembled, prototyped and tested in less than six months' on a tight budget

name: Miracly
description: AI驱动的营销平台,帮助企业监控和改善在AI搜索和回答引擎中的可见度,结合GEO分析、AI内容生成和自动化营销执行
description_en: AI-powered marketing platform that helps businesses monitor and improve visibility across AI search and answer engines, combining GEO analytics, AI content generation and automated marketing execution
why_matters: 2026年新成立的瑞典公司,2026年10月获得180万欧元pre-seed融资,提供AI代理在搜索、公关和效果营销方面的自动化建议
why_matters_en: Newly launched Swedish company in 2026, secured €1.8 million pre-seed funding in October 2026, offers AI agents providing recommendations across search, PR and performance marketing
latest_news_en: Announced €1.8 million in pre-Seed funding in October 2026
source_title: 15 startups helping AI discover your company and product | EU-Startups

evidence.quote: In October 2026, Miracly announced €1.8 million in pre-Seed funding

name: Visiblie
description: 帮助企业改善在AI生成搜索结果中的呈现,通过可见度测量、竞争对手基准测试和网站优化建议,并配备可在人工监督下实施改进的AI代理
description_en: Helps businesses improve how they appear in AI-generated search results through visibility measurement, competitor benchmarking and recommendations, with an AI agent capable of implementing improvements under human supervision
why_matters: 2025年成立的比利时公司,2026年7月获得50万欧元可转换贷款融资,其AI代理能够在人工监督下自动执行优化措施,计划进行后续种子轮融资
why_matters_en: Belgian startup founded in 2025, secured €500k convertible-loan financing in July 2026, its AI agent can autonomously implement selected improvements under human supervision, planning future Seed round
latest_news: 2026年7月获得50万欧元可转换贷款融资,公司表示计划进行未来的种子轮融资
latest_news_en: Secured €500k in convertible-loan financing in July 2026, with plans for a future Seed round
source_title: 15 startups helping AI discover your company and product | EU-Startups
